&2010
Metropolia leads with a ten percent share of all theses produced.
Sosiaali- and terveysala dominates as the primary field for thesis research.
Tekniikka and liikenne remains the second largest category of study.
Kulttuuriala maintains a significant presence within the top research fields.
Educational volume is concentrated in the top ten universities nationwide.

&2011
Oulun ammattikorkeakoulu rises to the top position in thesis output volume.
Metropolia falls to the second position in national thesis rankings.
Sosiaali- and terveysala remains the dominant academic field for students.
Kulttuuriala sees a slight increase in its total thesis share.
Field distributions show high stability across major study categories.

&2012
Metropolia regains the leading position for total thesis production share.
Tampereen ammattikorkeakoulu shows sustained growth in output and rankings.
Sosiaali- and terveysala continues to drive over thirty percent of total production.
Yhteiskuntatieteiden and liiketalouden fields experience moderate growth in share.
The top tier universities maintain consistent research output percentages.

&2013
Metropolia cements its position as the top university for thesis completion.
Kulttuuriala reaches a peak share of output during this period.
Sosiaali- and terveysala remains the most productive field for research.
Yhteiskuntatieteiden and liiketalouden fields continue to expand their influence.
University rankings demonstrate stability among the top five institutions.

&2014
Metropolia continues to lead with over ten percent of national thesis output.
Yhteiskuntatieteiden and liiketalouden fields see a steady upward trend in share.
Luonnontieteiden ala output increases compared to previous annual data.
Top universities show minimal changes in their relative thesis shares.
Sosiaali- and terveysala maintains its position as the clear primary focus.

&2015
Metropolia remains the dominant institution for student thesis completion.
Sosiaali- and terveysala accounts for over one-third of all academic output.
Tekniikan and liikenteen ala continues to provide significant research volume.
Laurea and LAB show strong competition in the mid-tier rankings.
University sector distributions remain heavily skewed toward major urban institutions.

&2016
Metropolia increases its lead with a record eleven percent share.
Terveys- and hyvinvointialat emerges as the new primary classification for research.
Kauppa and hallinto replaces earlier business classifications in the data.
Kasvatusalat becomes a distinct but smaller field of academic reporting.
Shift in reporting categories streamlines field-based data presentation.

&2017
Terveys- and hyvinvointialat reaches a high of thirty-seven percent share.
Metropolia continues to dominate with over twelve percent of total output.
Laurea and Tampereen show significant competition for third place rankings.
Tekniikan alat share experiences a slight decline in relative importance.
Kasvatusalat sees growth in its share of total produced theses.

&2018
Metropolia maintains the largest thesis volume among Finnish universities.
Terveys- and hyvinvointialat remains the central focus of academic research.
Tietojenkäsittely and tietoliikenne emerge as rapidly growing fields of study.
Tekniikan alat sees a recovery in its annual percentage share.
Tampereen ammattikorkeakoulu enters the top three university rankings.

&2019
Metropolia sees a slight dip in output share yet remains first.
Tietojenkäsittely and tietoliikenne continue to capture a larger thesis share.
Terveys- and hyvinvointialat accounts for over one-third of all theses.
University output remains concentrated in the largest institutions.
Kasvatusalat output shows stability despite minor annual fluctuations.

&2020
Metropolia retains leadership despite shifts in university production shares.
Kauppa and hallinto fields show a significant rise in total share.
Terveys- and hyvinvointialat remains the most popular field of research.
Tampereen and Turun compete closely for the third university spot.
Overall field stability persists throughout the pandemic period.

&2021
Metropolia leads with an eleven percent share of academic research.
Haaga-Helia moves to the second position in university output rankings.
Terveys- and hyvinvointialat rises back toward its historic peak share.
Tietojenkäsittely and tietoliikenne demonstrate sustained growth in importance.
University rankings show increased volatility in the second tier.

&2022
Metropolia remains the top university despite a slight percentage drop.
Turun ammattikorkeakoulu rises to fourth place in thesis volume.
Kauppa and hallinto fields maintain a strong position above twenty percent.
Tietojenkäsittely and tietoliikenne hold a consistent share of research.
Oulun ammattikorkeakoulu enters the top eight university list.

&2023
Laurea rises to second place in total national thesis volume.
Metropolia continues to head the list of productive universities.
Tietojenkäsittely and tietoliikenne reach eight percent of all thesis output.
Terveys- and hyvinvointialat output shows strong absolute and relative growth.
University output is becoming more balanced among top institutions.

&2024
Metropolia maintains the top rank with substantial total volume.
Turun ammattikorkeakoulu moves into second place for thesis output.
Tietojenkäsittely and tietoliikenne see a sharp increase in research share.
Terveys- and hyvinvointialat remains the dominant research field nationally.
University standings show major shifts in the mid-tier rankings.

&2025
Metropolia strengthens its lead with over ten percent of output.
Tietojenkäsittely and tietoliikenne reach a record share of nearly ten percent.
Terveys- and hyvinvointialat remains the primary field for students.
Turun and Laurea occupy the top positions after the leader.
Long-term growth is evident in digital and health research sectors.
